tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
x=pd.read_excel('paquete/docs/endiseg_2021_fd.xlsx',sheet_name=None,header=None,dtype=str)
print(list(x))
t=x['TMODULO']
print(t.head(8).to_string())
import re
vars_=['P4_1','P4_2','P4_4','P4_7','NIV','P7_1','P7_1A','P8_1','P9_1','ENT','EST_DIS','UPM_DIS','FACTOR']
cur=None
for i,r in t.iterrows():
    vals=[str(v) for v in r if pd.notna(v)]
    if any(v in vars_ for v in vals): cur=True
    elif any(re.fullmatch(r'P\d+_\w+|[A-Z_]+',v) and v not in ('C','N') for v in vals[:3]) and cur and len(vals)>2: cur=False
    if cur: print(i,' | '.join(vals))
"
